title: fix: unlist dashboard-only promo route to unblock API docs
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Hid `/account/promo-codes/redeem` from the public OpenAPI reference because promo-code redemption is dashboard-only and API-key calls receive 403. Redemption behavior is unchanged. Added a schema test to keep the route out of the public docs; including it had prevented docs regeneration.
